info.title: BestoDine Public API
info.description: Read-only API for a restaurant's own orders, menu, sales, low-stock inventory and bookings. Available on Gold and above or as the "API keys & webhooks" add-on (feature key `publicApi`); otherwise every call returns 403 FEATURE_LOCKED. Field names are snake_case and stable within v1: new fields may be added, existing ones are not renamed or removed. The public API is read-only: any non-GET method returns 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED. Never exposed: customer phone numbers and e-mails, staff data, payment gateway ids, tokens, password hashes, idempotency keys, other restaurants' data. Webhooks are described under `webhooks`.

post.description: BestoDine POSTs a signed JSON event to your HTTPS endpoint. Delivery is at-least-once with retries (up to 6 attempts, backoff 1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, 6h); de-duplicate on the event `id`. Respond with any 2xx to acknowledge. An endpoint is switched off after repeated consecutive failures.

parameters.name: X-BestoDine-Signature
parameters.description: Format `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`. v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + "." + rawBody), hex. secret is the endpoint signing secret (whsec_...). Compare in constant time; reject timestamps older than about 5 minutes.

parameters.name: X-BestoDine-Delivery
parameters.description: Delivery row id (not the event id).

bearerAuth.description: Create a key in Admin > Developers (owner only). Shown once; only a hash is stored. Keys in the query string are NOT accepted. Scopes: read:orders, read:menu, read:sales, read:inventory, read:bookings; a call outside the key's scopes returns 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE.

apiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyHeader.description: Alternative to the Bearer header. Same key, same scopes.

branch_id.description: Branch id, null for single-location restaurants.

token_number.description: Token number when token mode is enabled.

Order.description: Order. Fields are an explicit allow-list (utils/publicApiSerializers.js: serializeOrder).

from.description: Start of range (default: 30 days ago, 00:00 UTC).

to.description: End of range, null when open-ended.

SalesSummary.description: Paid, non-cancelled orders in the range.

id.description: Event id (evt_...). Deliveries are at-least-once: de-duplicate on this.

BookingCreatedEvent.description: A table or hall booking is made.

StockLowEvent.description: An inventory item drops to low / out of stock.

From.name: from
From.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or full ISO timestamp. Max range 366 days.

To.name: to
To.description: ISO date or timestamp. A bare date includes that whole day (UTC).

BadRequest.description: 400. Codes: INVALID_DATE, INVALID_RANGE, RANGE_TOO_LARGE, INVALID_FILTER, INVALID_BRANCH.

example.message: Rate limit exceeded for this API key. Slow down and retry.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per window for this key (default 120 per minute).

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.
